title: Trace and golden rows, the constraint sweep and run deletion
question: Do the v1 trace rows and the golden-run rows fit D3's tables, does every constraint fire on its bad row, and does run deletion behave as D3 §8 says?
method: Four pages' renditions and segments, the twelve core units of the v1 reference (stored form) as entities, claims, evidence, supports and one derived link; a golden run with passes a = SV, b = HV, c = v1 reference and items; a second run with reuse and a late task. Constraint sweep: the brief's three bad rows, a mutated copy of an existing row for every CHECK, NOT NULL, FK, UNIQUE and composite PK, and six invariants the database does not express, in one rolled-back transaction. Run 2's materialized rows deleted by run_id with plans. PostgreSQL 18.6 (Ubuntu 18.6-1.pgdg24.04+2), pg_textsearch 1.5.1, vector 0.8.7, on the project-local cluster (just db-up; socket build/pg/run, port 5440, pg_textsearch preloaded); DDL applied and rows written as the NOLOGIN non-superuser cs_s6_app (SET ROLE) in cs_spike_s6 cloned from cs_template; psycopg 3.3.6 (binary), pgvector-python 0.5.1, spike venv checked against the lock (`uv sync --locked --check`: no changes) before the final run; free disk 109G at start, 106G at end.

agents.separation: coordinator brief; wrote only code/s6_*, code/s6*.py/.sql, results/s6/, records/s6.*

results.name: constraint_cases_passed
results.note: includes the brief's three (claim_check, entity_check, golden_pass.model NOT NULL) and six repository-only invariants that insert without error

results.name: context_premise_evidence_returned
results.note: U12 c_X_stdgamma cites c1 (7103–7191) before the unit (7253); evidence query unit_id null (smallest segment a sentence)

results.name: golden_items
results.note: 2 with context set (U12 st0 and its premise)

results.name: run_deletion
results.note: run row and tasks kept; kb.claim_link has no run_id index (seq scan; the claim cascade removes links anyway); claim subject/object/statement RI checks reach claim_subject/claim_object/claim_statement only by skip scan; eval.alignment.golden_item_id unindexed

results.name: v1_misfits
results.note: U6 e_last_result: a Statement-typed entity without a kind fails entity_check; its claim c_follows not loaded (OPEN-D1-5)

conclusion: The v1 trace rows and the golden-run rows fit D3 with one reference misfit (a Statement-typed entity without a kind, an OPEN-D1-5 external reference). All 420 constraint cases behave as expected, including the brief's three bad rows; span bounds, span and segment text, cross-rendition evidence, distinct pass sessions and items only on pass c are repository checks, as expected. Run deletion keeps the run and its tasks and uses run_id indexes except on kb.claim_link, which the claim cascade covers.
